Santa Rosa Seaclusion by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Santa Rosa Seaclusion is a sensational, pet-friendly home in Seagrove Beach. The large deck is a great place to start your day with a cup of coffee, or an evening BBQ on the grill. Your family will enjoy the huge backyard. The beautiful beaches are a quick bike ride away, or an easy jaunt down the street. Inside, the first-floor guest rooms share a bath. Enjoy the covered patio area outside one of the guest rooms.

Upstairs, the open living, dining, and kitchen area is roomy, yet cozy. A sofa bed is in the living room. Down the hall, a primary bedroom, king, includes a double vanity and walk-in shower. The third floor includes a loft with 2 twin bunk beds, perfect for the kids. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 400 steps (.2 mi) to the beach (Walton Dunes Access) - 3 bedrooms and loft, 2 baths - 1766 sq ft - Wi-Fi - Gas grill - 3 bikes included - Dogs considered, an additional $210 nonrefundable fee for each dog Overnight: - Queen in 1st floor guest room; shared bath, TV - Queen and two twins (bunk bed) in 1st-floor guest room; shared bath, TV - King in 2nd floor primary bedroom, private bath, TV - Queen sleeper sofa in 2nd floor living room - 4 twin (2 bunk beds) in 3rd floor loft Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
